movie.title: Ballistic
movie.overview: When a soldier's mother discovers the bullet that killed her son in Afghanistan was made at the factory where she works, she sets out on a path of revenge against those responsible.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Devastated by her son's death in combat, a factory worker discovers the fatal bullet was manufactured at her own workplace and embarks on a dark quest for answers and retribution.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Nance Redfield is a factory worker at an Ohio munitions plant where she helps manufacture military ammunition while her son, Jesse, serves in Afghanistan. When Jesse is killed in combat, Nance demands answers and makes the harrowing discovery that the bullet that took his life matched the ammunition produced at her own plant. Consumed by grief and anger, she begins investigating how American-made munitions ended up in the hands of enemy combatants. As her single-minded pursuit of justice intensifies, Nance faces devastating personal costs and confronts the brutal gray areas of military conflict.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Nance Redfield leads a modest, working-class life in Ohio, manufacturing bullets for the defense industry while counting down the days until her deployed son, Jesse, returns from Afghanistan. She also supports Jesse's pregnant wife, Diana, as they both anxiously await his safe homecoming. Tragically, military officials arrive at Nance's door to deliver the devastating news that Jesse has been killed in action during combat. Overwhelmed by shock and unable to accept vague official explanations, Nance insists on discovering the exact circumstances surrounding her son's death. Her obsession drives her to examine the fatal bullet, only to make a shattering discovery: the round was manufactured directly at her own workplace. Realizing that American-made ammunition was supplied to enemy combatants, Nance spirals into intense grief and blinding rage against those responsible. Seeking answers, she connects with Kahlil, a former Afghan interpreter turned grief counselor who attempts to help her navigate her trauma, though her anger remains uncontained. Nance begins targeting those around her, confronting her factory boss and disrupting operations as her mental state becomes increasingly fragile. Ultimately, her destructive path forces her to face the brutal reality of war, systemic corruption, and the tragic price of endless vengeance.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Ballistic is an emotionally charged thriller and drama that follows Nance Redfield, a blue-collar Ohio woman working at a defense manufacturing plant. While daily hardship and supporting her pregnant daughter-in-law define her routine, her world revolves around her son Jesse's military deployment in Afghanistan. When tragedy strikes and Jesse is killed in action, Nance's grief transforms into an obsessive search for truth. Upon uncovering that the fatal bullet came from her own factory, she embarks on a dangerous crusade to uncover how American munitions reached enemy forces, pushing her relationships and sanity to the limit.

story_structure.risingAction: Driven by grief and rage, she begins investigating the factory's operations and executives, uncovering systemic corruption and embarking on a dangerous path of targeted revenge.
